title: Moose (delta migrations)
description: MooseStack 0.6.521 running the delta-based migration workflow (features.migrate_with_deltas = true). Paired with moose-legacy-migrations to isolate the impact of the feature flag on agent performance.
postInstallScript: mkdir -p /opt/dec-bench/moose && cd /opt/dec-bench/moose && npm init -y && npm install @514labs/moose-lib@0.6.521
